# components

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/components.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `components` component of `libs/platform`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.component`: generated from its catalogue, [components.json](../../libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/components.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on the federation entity: its Entity Configuration, fetch, list, resolve, Trust Mark and historical-keys endpoints, and explicit registration: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS, OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES, OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHOR_JWKS, OIDF_FEDERATION_SELF_ANCHOR, OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_MARK_TYPES, OIDF_FEDERATION_ENDPOINT_AUTH | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on automatic registration (OpenID Federation 1.0 §12.1) at the token, authorization and PAR endpoints: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST, OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_BASE_URL, OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_FAIL_CLOSED, OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_FRONT_CHANNEL | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_AUTH_ENABLED`; superseded, still read: `OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_BRIDGE_KEY` (system property `oidf.attestation.require.bridge.key`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_BRIDGE_KEY`) | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on attest_jwt_client_auth at the token and PAR endpoints: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_BRIDGE_SIGNER_BACKING, OIDF_BRIDGE_SIGNING_KEYS, OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_ATTESTER_BINDING, OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_HOSTED_AGENT | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_ISSUER_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on the client attester's issuance endpoint, /federation/attestation: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_ATTESTER_SIGNING_JWK, OIDF_ATTESTER_FEDERATION_ENTITY, OIDF_ATTESTER_OP_ISSUER, OIDF_ATTESTER_CIMD_URL, OIDF_ATTESTER_SPIRE_ENTRIES_URL | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_HOSTING_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on hosting subordinate entities for this authority, /federation/agents and /federation/resources: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_AUTHORITY_ENTITY_ID, OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL, OIDF_AUTHORITY_DATA_STORE_ID, OIDF_OPENBAO_URL | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on the Shared Signals transmitter: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_SSF_ISSUER, OIDF_SSF_JDBC_URL, OIDF_SSF_DATA_STORE_ID. Not applied yet: the SSF servlets start as their own settings say until ST-5 moves their start-up onto the component parts (Phase 3, wave 3); until then this switch is catalogued and parsed, and changes nothing | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on the Shared Signals receiver of inbound SETs: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_EXPECTED_ISSUER, OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_JWKS_URL, OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_URL. Not applied yet: the SSF servlets start as their own settings say until ST-5 moves their start-up onto the component parts (Phase 3, wave 3); until then this switch is catalogued and parsed, and changes nothing | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_OPERATOR_API_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on the federation operator API, /federation/admin: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FAPI_ENABLED` | Unset; one of `true`, `false` | Switches on FAPI 2.0 enforcement for the clients it names: true or false; unset, inferred from its settings - always in development, and in production only while none of these is set: OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS | **Doesn't start**: Not true or false, unset in production while one of its settings is set, or true without the settings it needs: the component is FAILED_CONFIG and its surfaces answer 503; PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving | Any | Yes |
